name: Moomba Gas Plant
description: Santos-operated gas processing plant in the Cooper Basin, South Australia, the primary source of gas feeding the Moomba hub and the SWQP, MSP and MAP pipelines.

name: Moomba Compression Facility (MCF)
description: Central compression and metering facility at Moomba linking Cooper Basin gas fields to the South West Queensland (SWQP), Moomba-Sydney (MSP) and Moomba-Adelaide (MAP) pipelines via its Low Pressure (MLP) and High Pressure (MHP) points.

name: Ballera
description: Ballera processing and compressor facility in the Cooper Basin, Queensland, the western origin point of the South West Queensland Pipeline (SWQP).

name: Gooimbah
description: Junction point on the South West Queensland Pipeline corridor, connecting through to the Queensland Gas Pipeline (QGP) and the Wallumbilla hub.

name: Rolleston
description: Compression/valve point on the Queensland Gas Pipeline north of Wallumbilla, near gas fields including Fairview and Yellowbank.

name: Yellowbank
description: Upstream gas field supplying into the Rolleston junction on the Queensland Gas Pipeline.

name: Fairview
description: Santos GLNG's coal seam gas processing hub in the Fairview field north of Roma, around Injune. The northern end of the Comet Ridge to Wallumbilla Pipeline.

name: Banana
description: Junction on the Queensland Gas Pipeline connecting toward Rockhampton, Gladstone and Wide Bay, and on to the Curtis Island LNG projects.

name: Rockhampton
description: Regional Queensland demand centre served off the Queensland Gas Pipeline via the Banana junction.

name: Gladstone
description: Industrial port city and home to the Curtis Island LNG export precinct, served off the Queensland Gas Pipeline.

name: Wide Bay
description: Regional demand centre served off the Queensland Gas Pipeline via the Banana junction.

name: GLNG (Curtis Island)
description: Santos-operated LNG export facility on Curtis Island, sourcing coal seam gas from the Roma/Fairview fields via the Queensland Gas Pipeline network.

name: Wallumbilla Hub (WAL)
description: Australia's main east coast gas trading hub, near Roma. The interconnection point for nine pipelines: SWQP, RBP, QGP, BWP, RCWP, CRWP and the Darling Downs Pipeline (which carries both the Spring Gully and Darling Downs streams), plus the GLNG lean gas stream. The umbrella WAL location covers separate High and Low Pressure trading points, joined by APA's two on-site compression facilities, and the connections meet it on numbered runs - AEMO names Runs 6, 7 and 9 on the Darling Downs Pipeline alone.

name: APLNG (Curtis Island)
description: Origin/ConocoPhillips-operated LNG export facility on Curtis Island, connected into the Wallumbilla network via the PPL 134 lateral.

name: QGC (Curtis Island)
description: Shell-operated (QGC) LNG export facility on Curtis Island, connected into the Wallumbilla/Ellengrove network via the PPL 133 lateral.

name: Condamine
description: Coal seam gas field feeding into the Windibri junction on the Roma Brisbane Pipeline (RBP).

name: Windibri
description: Junction on the Roma Brisbane Pipeline (RBP) linking QGC-owned gathering infrastructure and the Braemar power station laterals into the main RBP corridor.

name: Scotia
description: Upstream gas field in the Surat Basin feeding the Wallumbilla hub area.

name: Berwyndale
description: Upstream coal seam gas field in the Surat Basin feeding the Wallumbilla hub area.

name: Talinga
description: Upstream coal seam gas field in the Surat Basin feeding the Wallumbilla hub area.

name: Argyle
description: Compression point on the Roma Brisbane Pipeline between Windibri and Dalby.

name: Dalby
description: Regional Queensland demand centre on the Roma Brisbane Pipeline.

name: Oakey
description: Regional Queensland demand centre on the Roma Brisbane Pipeline, near the Oakey compressor station.

name: Braemar Power Station Laterals
description: Laterals off the Windibri junction supplying the Braemar 1 and Braemar 2 gas-fired power stations, and the Tipton delivery point.

name: Ellengrove
description: Junction near Brisbane connecting the Roma Brisbane Pipeline and the QGC lateral (PPL 133) into the Brisbane STTM.

name: Brisbane STTM
description: Short Term Trading Market hub for Brisbane, the eastern terminus of the Roma Brisbane Pipeline (RBP).

name: Toowoomba
description: Regional demand centre served off the Roma Brisbane Pipeline network (non-hub delivery point).

name: Bella Park CS
description: Compressor station on the Moomba Sydney Pipeline (MSP) shortly after the Moomba MSP inlet.

name: Wilton
description: Compressor station on the Moomba Sydney Pipeline (MSP) near its Sydney end, also a delivery point referenced in gas trading contracts. MSP's real terminus and Jemena's actual receipt point into the Sydney network.

name: Young
description: Junction on the Moomba Sydney Pipeline (MSP) in central NSW.

name: Sydney STTM
description: Notional Short Term Trading Market reference point for the Sydney gas market. Physically fed via Jemena's local Sydney distribution network (its Central/Southern/Northern Trunk mains) from the two real receipt points, Wilton (MSP) and Horsley Park (EGP), rather than being a further transmission-pipeline hop past either of them.

name: Horsley Park
description: Sydney-area distribution hub connected to the Eastern Gas Pipeline (EGP).

name: ACT (Canberra)
description: Canberra-area demand centre, served both off the Eastern Gas Pipeline network via Hoskinstown and off the Moomba Sydney Pipeline (MSP) via the Dalton to Canberra lateral.

name: Dalton
description: Small NSW town on the Moomba Sydney Pipeline (MSP) mainline, origin of the Dalton to Canberra lateral.

name: Hoskinstown
description: Junction on the Eastern Gas Pipeline (EGP) serving the Canberra (ACT) lateral.

name: Culcairn
description: Compressor station at the Victoria-NSW interconnect, linking the Victorian gas network to the NSW network.

name: Cooma
description: Southern NSW town on the Eastern Gas Pipeline (EGP) route between Victoria and Sydney.

name: Bombala
description: Southern NSW town on the Eastern Gas Pipeline (EGP) route, close to the Victorian border.

name: Orbost
description: East Gippsland junction where the Eastern Gas Pipeline (EGP) begins its run from Longford toward NSW.

name: Wollert CS
description: Compressor station north of Melbourne on the Victoria-NSW interconnect corridor.

name: Eurora CS
description: Compressor station on the Victoria-NSW interconnect corridor between Wollert and Culcairn.

name: Springhurst CS
description: Compressor station on the Victoria-NSW interconnect corridor near the NSW border.

name: Melbourne (VTS)
description: Melbourne-area gas demand hub on the Victorian Transmission System (VTS), the network of trunk pipelines and city gates APA operates around Melbourne, fed by the Longford gas plant and the SEA Gas/Iona system.

name: Longford Gas Plant
description: ExxonMobil/Esso-Woodside operated gas processing plant in the Gippsland Basin, Victoria, the principal source for the Eastern Gas Pipeline (EGP), Tasmanian Gas Pipeline (TGP) and the Melbourne network (GNP).

name: Iona Underground Storage
description: Underground gas storage facility near Port Campbell, western Victoria, and connection point for Otway Basin production feeding the SEA Gas Pipeline (PCA) and Melbourne.

name: Adelaide STTM
description: Short Term Trading Market hub for Adelaide, fed by the Moomba Adelaide Pipeline (MAP) and the SEA Gas Pipeline (PCA) from Victoria.

name: Bell Bay (Tasmania)
description: Tasmanian receiving point for the Tasmanian Gas Pipeline (TGP), which runs under Bass Strait from Longford.

name: Wagga Wagga
description: Southern NSW regional centre on the Central West gas network, connected to the Moomba Sydney Pipeline via Young.

name: Griffith
description: Riverina regional centre supplied via the Junee to Griffith lateral off the Wagga Wagga gas network.

name: Lithgow
description: Central Tablelands NSW town on the Young to Lithgow lateral off the Moomba Sydney Pipeline.

name: Orange
description: Central West NSW regional centre served by a spur off the Young to Lithgow lateral.

name: Dubbo
description: Central West NSW regional centre at the western end of the Central West Pipeline, and the southern end of the Central Ranges Pipeline.

name: Tamworth
description: New England NSW regional centre at the northern end of the Central Ranges Pipeline.

name: Mount Isa
description: North-west Queensland mining town, northern terminus of the Carpentaria Gas Pipeline.

name: Cannington Mine
description: South32 silver-lead-zinc mine served by the Cannington Lateral off the Carpentaria Gas Pipeline.

name: Cannington Junction (CGP)
description: Where the Cannington Lateral taps off the Carpentaria Gas Pipeline (CGP) mainline.

name: Port Pirie
description: South Australian industrial town (lead smelter), served by a lateral off the Moomba Adelaide Pipeline (MAP).

name: Whyalla
description: South Australian steelworks town, served by a lateral off the Moomba Adelaide Pipeline (MAP).

name: Angaston
description: Barossa Valley, SA demand centre served by a lateral off the Moomba Adelaide Pipeline (MAP).

name: Port Pirie/Whyalla Junction (MAP)
description: Where the Port Pirie and Whyalla laterals tap off the Moomba Adelaide Pipeline (MAP) mainline.

name: Angaston Junction (MAP)
description: Where the Angaston lateral taps off the Moomba Adelaide Pipeline (MAP) mainline.

name: Peat
description: Upstream gas field, northern end of the Scotia/Peat Lateral off the Roma Brisbane Pipeline (RBP) via Condamine.

name: Burnt Creek
description: Junction on the Young to Wagga Wagga lateral where the Burnt Creek to Griffith pipeline branches off.

name: Cheepie
description: Junction on the South West Queensland Pipeline (SWQP) mainline where the Cheepie to Barcaldine Gas Pipeline branches off.

name: Gilmore Junction
description: Mid-point junction on the Cheepie to Barcaldine Gas Pipeline.

name: Barcaldine
description: Central Queensland town, home to Ergon Energy's gas-fired power station, served by the Cheepie to Barcaldine Gas Pipeline.

name: Kogan
description: Active compressor station on the Roma Brisbane Pipeline (RBP) mainline, part of its looped DN400 section.

name: Wollongong
description: Illawarra regional centre served by a lateral off the Eastern Gas Pipeline (EGP) network via Wilton.

name: Port Kembla
description: Port Kembla LNG import terminal and STTM delivery point, served off the Eastern Gas Pipeline (EGP) network via Wollongong.

name: Tallawarra Power Station
description: Gas-fired power station near Wollongong, served by the Tallawarra Spur off the Port Kembla lateral.

name: Wallumbilla HP
description: High Pressure trading point at the Wallumbilla hub (up to 10.2 MPa), and the compression delivery point on Wallumbilla Compression Facilities A and B. AEMO's service point register lists its physical delivery streams as BWP Exit, QGP Exit, RBP Exit, RCWP, and CRWP runs WCS2 and WCS3. Also a receipt point back onto the SWQP, and one of its two park service points.

name: Wallumbilla LP
description: Low Pressure trading point at the Wallumbilla hub (max 9.6 MPa), and the compression receipt point on Wallumbilla Compression Facilities A and B; moving gas onward into the HP side requires compression. AEMO's register lists its physical receipt streams as BWP, the Darling Downs Pipeline, QGP Entry, RBP Entry, Spring Gully, RCWP, and the GLNG lean gas stream.

name: Spring Gully Gas Plant
description: Coal seam gas processing hub in the Bowen Basin, about 55 km east of Injune. The northern end of the Darling Downs Pipeline: AEMO's register lists the Spring Gully Manifold and Taloona as its receipt points, and folds the old Spring Gully Pipeline into the DDP.

name: Reedy Creek Gas Plant
description: Australia Pacific LNG processing facility roughly 65 km south-west of Wandoan, and the far end of APA's Reedy Creek to Wallumbilla Pipeline. AEMO lists the RCWP receipting here from both the APLNG pipeline and the Senex Atlas gas pipeline.

name: Darling Downs Power Station
description: Gas-fired power station at Kogan, 40 km west of Dalby. The delivery end of the Darling Downs Pipeline, and the only service point on it AEMO does not publish.

name: Wallumbilla Run 3
description: Metering run at the Wallumbilla hub, on the high pressure side by the RBP interconnect trade point. Used as an RBP receipt point for forward haul out of Wallumbilla.

name: Wallumbilla Run 6
description: Metering run at the Wallumbilla hub. A Darling Downs Pipeline delivery point, sharing a delivery zone with Run 7 and the Wallumbilla Compressor Station.

name: Wallumbilla Run 7
description: Metering run at the Wallumbilla hub. A Darling Downs Pipeline delivery point, sharing a delivery zone with Run 6 and the Wallumbilla Compressor Station.

name: Wallumbilla Run 9
description: Metering run at the Wallumbilla hub. A Darling Downs Pipeline delivery point, and the only one AEMO puts in a delivery zone of its own.

name: Moomba LP Trade Point
description: Low pressure point at Moomba: gas enters here from the gas fields and plants. The SWQP receipt side, and the compression receipt point on the Moomba Compression Facility - moving gas from here to the HP side needs compression.

name: Moomba HP Trade Point
description: High pressure point at Moomba: the outlet of the Moomba Compression Facility, and the receipt point on the SWQP. Gas is sent from here into the adjacent pipelines, and it is one of the SWQP's two park service points.

name: Wilton Trade Point
description: Notional trade point at the Wilton end of the Moomba to Sydney Pipeline, used as the delivery point for forward haul down the MSP.

name: Culcairn Trade Point
description: Notional trade point on the Moomba to Sydney Pipeline at Culcairn, the delivery point for forward haul from the MSP inlet.

name: RBP Trade Point (IPT)
description: Notional interconnect trade point on the Roma to Brisbane Pipeline, allocated to the Kogan receipt and delivery zone. Both a forward haul receipt and a delivery point, and the RBP side of trades into Condamine and the Brisbane STTM.
